Q5661.reason: An offer with no promise to hold open and no consideration is freely revocable, whereas the others are firm offers by a merchant in a signed writing, a telegraph, or an option supported by consideration.

Q5663.reason: Intending only to wound negates the deliberate intention to kill required for malice under §170, whereas transferred intent defeats A and negligence in D would still not fit the statute as well.

Q5665.reason: An employer held vicariously liable is entitled to full indemnity from the negligent employee, regardless of insurance.
